cases.prompt: I just installed this, where do I start?
reject: importing anything before asking what they want to share

cases.prompt: What can you actually read on my computer?
reject: claiming it can ingest email, calendar or notes into the people store
hedging about whether data leaves the machine

cases.prompt: How do I get my Google Drive in here?
reject: inventing an import command for Drive
telling them to download everything including video and photos

cases.prompt: Why does it keep asking for permission to see my messages?
reject: pasting a permissions table instead of explaining it

cases.prompt: I want to get my life organized in this thing
reject: starting with more than one data source
promising features that are not built
saying yes without noting that mail is readable through mac but not ingested into the people store
